{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse, relaxed collar fit, knee length, #f5f0e6, fine woven fabric.
Tailored charcoal grey wool-blend trousers, straight leg, full length, #3d3d40, heavy drape fabric.
Structured beige cashmere cardigan, open front, hip length, #cbbba2, soft knit fabric.
Leather ballet flats, rounded toe, ankle height, #8b7d6b, smooth calf leather.

This outfit works because it strikes the right balance for a banking interview, offering a polished and professional silhouette that commands respect without being overly rigid. The neutral palette of cream, charcoal, and beige feels sophisticated and grounded, perfectly suiting the conservative atmosphere of a financial institution while adhering to her strict request to avoid black clothing. The inclusion of the cardigan adds a layer of warmth appropriate for autumn weather, and the comfortable ballet flats ensure she can stand confidently through the duration of the meeting without sacrificing style or formality."}
